text.title: Embeddings Evaluation Decision Tree
text.summary: Blocks on golden-set size and provenance, then decides whether the offline winner is statistically separated enough to ship or must go to a live A/B. Every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the golden set hold at least 50 query-passage triples, each query with at least one relevant passage graded?

conclusion.verdict: do not rank models yet; build the golden set from usage logs or SME annotation first, then return.

branch.question: Do the headline queries come from real usage logs or SME authorship, with any synthetic rows flagged and reported separately?

conclusion.verdict: replace or flag the synthetic queries; a ranking on synthetic queries measures paraphrase recall, not retrieval quality.

branch.question: On the 20% hold-out, does the top candidate's bootstrap 95% CI on the primary metric clear the runner-up's, with a paired test p below 0.05?

conclusion.verdict: ship the offline winner; record evaluated_at, exact model ids, golden-set version and a stale_by date within 90 days.
escalate to a live A/B of the top two with click-through or citation-accuracy telemetry; do not ship on point estimates.
split 20% of queries out before any chunking, prompt or fine-tuning decision; headline numbers come from the hold-out only.
rewrite the grading guideline and re-annotate; the metric is measuring annotator disagreement, not the models.
